source.title: จับจังหวะการกลับตัวของหุ้นด้วย RSI
source.author: พงศ์พัฒน์ ค้ำชู, CMT, CAIA, CISA

evidence_to_test: Bullish RSI divergence: price makes a lower low while RSI makes a higher low
Use a bullish reversal candlestick as confirmation rather than treating divergence as an automatic entry
Test mean-reversion in weaker-trend regimes using ADX as a regime proxy
Next-day entry after confirmation to avoid same-bar look-ahead

luna_translation.selection: M1 bottom-20 by 20-day momentum at month-end
luna_translation.divergence: causal rolling-window proxy; no future bars
luna_translation.confirmation: Hammer or Bullish Engulfing within 5/10 trading days
